page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Marginal notes "Cap.7." and "Cap.3." in the right margin, each beside its line. Quotation marks in the right margin beside the first lines. Catchword "prorsus" at the right below the last line.

main_text.p: innato calido inscripsit, spiritus naturam perspicuè demonstrat. Est (inquit) spiritus corpus æthereum caloris, facultatumq; se- des & uinculum, primumq; obeundæ fun- ctionis instrumentum. Quibus uerbis spi- ritum corpus esse aperte declarat. At libro Cap.7. de Abditis rerum causis secundo, spiritum aliquid esse diuersum à corpore, & humo- ribus profert. Quæ sane cohærere nequeunt. Idem enim & corpus esse, & non corpus nequit: quandoquidem contradicentia sunt. Deinde si spiritus est substantia cœlestis & ætherea, quì, quæso, accendi aut refrigerari poterit? At spiritum per ephemeras febres accendi profitentur omnes medici. Quod utriq; ostendit ipse Fernelius libro de Fe- Cap.3. bribus, ubi ephemeram febrē esse calorem præter naturā in spiritu primum considen- tem ait. His adde quod per utranq; synco- pen, nempe stomachicam & cardiacam spi- ritum refrigerari apud omnes medicos est in confesso. Igitur spiritus potest tum ac- cendi, tum deferbere. Quod cum ita sit, i- sum non esse æthereram substantiam, nec à cœlo originem ducere confequens est. Ni hil enim cœleste naturaliter mutari potest, quandoquidem contrario, à quo patiatur, prorsus

page.notes: The small marks "„" in the right margin beside the first lines are printed quotation marks, not text, so they are not transcribed. The "Cap.7." and "Cap.3." notes have no letter reference mark in the text. The "C" of PROGYMNASMATA in the running head is slightly blurred and was read as G. The letter in "li/si" at the start of the fifth-from-last full line is uncertain. Possible printing errors are left as printed, e.g. "æthereram", "cum", "primum" without accent.
